name: api-stability-tier
_stage_vocabulary_ruling: This vocabulary is [preview, stable, GA] because that is the repo's canonical API-stability tier set, confirmed three independent ways: docs/machine-readable/contracts.json `_metadata.stability_tiers`, `enum ApiStability` in intelligence/core/catalog-domain/src/lib.rs, and marketplace/facade/dev-cli/src/governance_gates.rs validate_claim_ceiling_gate, which runs FoundationClaimCeiling::preview_foundation() over this exact directory and caps every record at Preview. The earlier {experimental, stable, deprecated, removed} list was a different vocabulary sharing one token, so the lane reported 750 unknown_stage against 750 artifacts. A 100% failure rate on a SINGLE code is a config-mismatch signature, not a debt signature: sample the declared values before proposing a baseline. Freezing those 750 would also have been a trap rather than debt, because the only remedy — declaring higher tiers per crate — is precisely what the claim-ceiling gate rejects, so no permitted action could ever have reduced the count. `defaults.case_insensitive_stage_match` is true, so GA needs no second lowercase spelling. Transitions encode the monotone ladder Preview < Stable < Ga that `enum ApiStability` derives via Ord; there is no deprecation or removal tier in this vocabulary, so no stage requires a supersession edge.
_transitions_are_declarative: READ THIS BEFORE TREATING `transitions` AS ENFORCEMENT: it is DECLARATIVE ONLY and no lane evaluates it. ViolationKind::IllegalTransition is raised solely by iterating `artifact.history` (libs/oya-governance-lifecycle-kernel/src/lib.rs, `for t in &artifact.history` in evaluate()), and discover() constructs EVERY LifecycledArtifact with `history: vec![]` (same file, in the per-file read loop). So the history is empty for every artifact of every lane, and no declared edge is ever checked: a record moving preview -> GA directly would pass unnoticed. This is inherited kernel-wide behaviour, identical at merge-base 8857944612, not anything specific to this lane. It cannot be repaired at this config either, because a per-file YAML snapshot carries no transition log — every SourceSpec in this repo globs CURRENT-state records, so there is no history corpus anywhere for discover() to feed the evaluator. The array is retained rather than deleted because it documents the monotone ladder Preview < Stable < Ga that `enum ApiStability` derives via Ord, and because every other lifecycle config declares transitions the same way: removing it from this one lane would create an inconsistency without retiring the class.
purpose: Lifecycle state machine for API stability tier transitions across registry/catalog records, from preview through GA.
